subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should generated WSL gateways support separately opt-in Tailscale identity authentication as a core authorization path, or should the integration provide private Serve transport only?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but accepting tailnet identity and ACL policy as part of gateway authorization is a permanent security and product contract that automation cannot approve.

options.title: Approve opt-in identity trust
options.body: Accept the separately disclosed setting with root-owned Tailscale administration, preserved token and device flows, Funnel rejection, and focused security proof.

options.title: Use transport only
options.body: Provision private Serve connectivity while requiring normal OpenClaw token or paired-device authentication for every connection.

options.title: Defer core integration
options.body: Pause the PR if the project does not want to own Tailscale provisioning and authentication policy in Windows onboarding.

recommendation.title: Approve opt-in identity trust
recommendation.body: Accept the separately disclosed setting with root-owned Tailscale administration, preserved token and device flows, Funnel rejection, and focused security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available routing candidate for the explicit authentication-boundary decision discussed on the PR.
